state.objective: Close the remaining ambiguities in the client-only revised COA and determine the defensible account count.
facts: The client COA has 36 item-specific Reserve Replacement OE balance-sheet families and 36 corresponding Biaya Replacement OE expense families.
All these reserve and expense lines are zero in the available December 2025 balance sheet and 2025/2024 P&L.
The client has an asset register containing the underlying OE items by item type and site.
No contract, policy or roll-forward demonstrates a present legal or constructive replacement obligation.
The owner wants item-specific Replacement OE accounts compressed as far as safely possible.
The client has formal PJP Jatuh Tempo Principal and Pinjaman Jangka Panjang Principal families, plus Hutang Lain-lain Principal by HO/unit.
Formal Principal loan maturity can be managed in loan schedules.
No agreement proves that every Hutang Lain-lain Principal balance has the same repayment/subordination terms as formal Principal loans.
All units are cost centers/sites of one legal entity.
already_accepted_client_only_changes: Replace invented GRNI with existing Supplier Merchandise Suspend family.
Add three affiliation control natures: Financing, Goods and Other.
Add Software cost and Accumulated Amortization Software.
Add HPP, Purchase Discount, CIP, income-tax expense, mixed other income/expense, Disposed Inventory and the requested land/HGB/rent and pre-opening families.
Use one Bank Loan and one formal Principal Loan with maturity schedule classification.
Giro Keluar is removed from future posting.

reserve_present_obligation.instructions: Does the available evidence support a permanent Reserve Replacement OE balance-sheet account?

criteria.no: Zero balances and no obligation policy/roll-forward do not support recognizing a reserve; retire it from future posting.
criteria.yes: The word Reserve alone supports a permanent balance-sheet account.

replacement_one_expense.instructions: After retiring the unsupported reserve, can all qualifying non-capital OE replacement costs use one Biaya Replacement OE natural account?

criteria.yes: Use item_id/OE type/site/reason in the asset or maintenance document; capital replacements go to OE assets.

replacement_total_core.instructions: How many Replacement OE natural accounts should remain in core under these facts?

criteria.one: One Biaya Replacement OE account; no reserve account absent a present obligation.

formal_principal_account.instructions: Should formal current and long-term Principal borrowing families become one Pinjaman Principal core account with maturity schedules?

criteria.yes: Use principal_id, facility_id and maturity schedule.

other_principal_account.instructions: Until its substance is proven identical to formal loans, should Hutang Lain-lain Principal have one separate core account rather than 14 unit accounts?

criteria.yes: Keep one Hutang Principal/Pihak Berelasi account with principal_id and cost center.
criteria.merge: Merge into formal Pinjaman Principal without evidence.

principal_count.instructions: How many Principal-related natural accounts should the immediate core contain?

criteria.two: Pinjaman Principal for formal facilities and Hutang Principal/Pihak Berelasi for other balances; merge later only with evidence.

affiliation_three_one_each.instructions: Given centralized HO-unit flows and the owner's requirement, can the core use exactly three affiliation control accounts—Financing, Goods and Other—with cost-center debit/credit balances?

criteria.yes: Use source documents and cost centers for both sides, eliminate at entity reporting and prevent entity-level external presentation.
criteria.six: Require separate debit and credit natural accounts for each nature.

affiliation_counterpart.instructions: Is a general counter_site_id required on journal lines for these three balances?

criteria.no: Each balanced document line carries its own cost center/site; origin/destination live on funding or transfer documents.
criteria.yes: Add a general counter-site dimension to every journal line.

counting_rule.instructions: When counting the final core, should a legacy family replaced by a normalized same-nature account count once, while unit/bank/item copies count as dimensions?

criteria.no: Count every legacy site and item copy.
